pages.text:
Golf
Alltrack
Whether you’re exploring new pavement or taking a detour onto
a dirt road, the Golf Alltrack is the key to unlocking destinations
that were once out of reach. Equipped with 4MOTION® all-wheel
drive, an Off-Road Mode,* and increased ground clearance to
accommodate varied terrain with more confidence, the Golf Alltrack
was designed to take the road less graveled. No matter how you
adventure, it’s safe to say you’ll be doing so with a turbocharged
smile on your face.
Tread happily.
*Always ensure that your vehicle is equipped with appropriate tires and equipment and always adjust your speed and driving style to the road, terrain, traffic, and weather conditions. See Owner’s Manual
for further details and important limitations.

pages.text:
Taking a detour off the highway to traverse previously
uncharted territories has its perks. Scenery. Fresh air.
Traction, under control.
Tranquility. But looking for adventure off the beaten
path doesn’t always mean a smooth drive. Fear not,
the Golf Alltrack was engineered with 4MOTION
all-wheel drive, Off-Road Mode,* and Hill Descent
Control, which actively helps control the application
of your brakes. Smoother sailing, even on rough
terrain and in inclement weather.
FEATURES
4MOTION all-wheel drive
Driving Mode Selection with Off-Road Mode
and Hill Descent Control
1.8L TSI® engine
4MOTION all-wheel drive
The 4MOTION all-wheel-drive system transfers torque between the front
and rear wheels. In normal driving conditions, power is delivered to the front
wheels. But 4MOTION can also send torque to the rear axle when you need it.
Talk about a power move.

pages.text:
When searching for a car designed for the outdoors,
it’s easy to compromise on aesthetics. Thankfully, the
Golf Alltrack is an all-around eye pleaser that checks
all the boxes. A rugged bumper design and exterior
cladding help weather the storms, while additional
ground clearance makes the Golf Alltrack nimble on
dirt, snow, and various terrain.* It’s part sporty wagon,
part rugged, and one all-wheel adventurer.
FEATURES
Silver roof rails
17" alloy wheels
AVAILABLE FEATURES
Bi-Xenon headlights with LED DRL
Panoramic sunroof
18" alloy wheels
Steering wheel-mounted paddle shifters
Hill Descent Control
This feature helps you go down steep grades that can be partially
slippery. With Hill Descent Control, active when in Off-Road Mode,*
the Golf Alltrack will brake for you while going downhill, keeping
your ride at a constant, controlled speed.
Off-Road Mode*
With a specialized engine and ABS configuration, Off-Road Mode is
designed to help you traverse a variety of different terrains; it allows
you to comfortably drive down steep grades and optimizes driving
and traction control. It’s “adventure mode for the off-road.“
Rugged bumper design and exterior cladding
A tough yet refined exterior, the Golf Alltrack is engineered with sleek
reinforcements to help combat rough road conditions and inclement
weather. In short, it’s ready for almost anything.*
Rugged good looks.
Increased ground clearance
Designed to allow easier maneuvering through varied terrain — like the
uneven rocky ground of a campsite — the increased ground clearance
of the Golf Alltrack shows how we went above and beyond, so you can
go out and about.
SEL with Driver Assistance and Lighting Package shown in Pure White with Base Carrier Bars and Bike Holder Attachment
